verdict.rationale: No evidence mentions an AI-training policy or opt-out. However, Jitsu is 100% open-source and can be self-hosted on-premise or on Kubernetes "fully under your control", which indirectly keeps data out of vendor hands. A DPA is also available for cloud users. missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training commitment for Jitsu Cloud data, a documented training opt-out control, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
